title: DealMint
tagline: Negotiate, pay in PYUSD, and settle cross-chain via Avail in seconds.
description:
DealMint is a negotiation-first checkout for Web3 payments.
It lets two parties agree on payment terms through a lightweight agentic negotiation (A2A -> AP2 mandate). Once both sides confirm, the app mints a signed "deal mandate".
The buyer pays in PayPal USD (PYUSD), and the system triggers Avail Nexus to settle the value cross-chain (e.g., Ethereum -> Base).
The result is a smooth, link-based checkout that feels like Web2 payments but runs entirely on open protocols - fast, verifiable, and composable.
how_its_made:
DealMint is built with Next.js, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, and Prisma + SQLite.
The on-chain layer uses wagmi + viem for EVM calls to transfer PYUSD, then the Avail Nexus SDK for cross-chain settlement and intent tracking.
The Negotiation Panel runs a small rule-based A2A engine that produces an AP2-style mandate stored in JSON.
Timeline events and receipts are synced in real time and linked to Etherscan and BaseScan.
The entire app is packaged as a Vercel-ready monorepo with pnpm workspaces - light, fast, and demo-friendly for ETHOnline.
